title: Prosthetics and Orthotics - Vocabulary, Part 2: Terms relating to external limb prostheses and wearers of these prostheses
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13970 (PART 2)) covers Prosthetics and Orthotics - Vocabulary, Part 2: Terms relating to external limb prostheses and wearers of these prostheses. This Indian Standard ( Part 1 ) was adopted by the finalized by the Artificial Limbs, Rehabilitation Appliances and Equipment for the Disabled Sectional Committee had been approved by the Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning Division Council. This standard ( Part 1 ) is one of a series establishing a vocabulary of terms used in the field of external limb prosthetics and external orthotics. It defines general terms used to describe external limb prostheses and orthoses. The other parts in this series are: Part 2 Terms relating to external limb prostheses and wearers of these prostheses, and Part 3 Terms relating to external orthoses. In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from ISO 8549- 1 : 1989 "Prosthetics and orthotics — Vocabulary — Part 1 : General terms for external limb prostheses and external orthoses', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). IS 13970 ( Part 1 ) : 1995 Indian Standard PROSTHETICS AND ORTHOTICS — VOCABULA
clause_3_terminology: Part 2: Terms relating to external limb prostheses and wearers of these prostheses

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
